US Core-Based Statistical Area Shapefile

Source: R/cbsa_sf.R
cbsa_sf.Rd

Useful sf object shapefile for US Core-Based Statistical Area.

Usage

cbsa_sf

Format

An object of class sf (inherits from data.frame) with 933 rows and 9 columns.

Rows: 933
Columns: 9
